class.name: NNBTSelector
class.brief_description: Tries child branches in order until one succeeds, or fails if all fail.
class.description: Use to create prioritized fallback logic (try the highest-priority branch first; if it fails, try the next). Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] as soon as a child succeeds, [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while a child is running, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] only if every enabled child fails. Enable [member reactive] if higher-priority branches should be re-checked every tick while a lower-priority branch is running (interrupting it if a higher-priority branch takes over). For randomized fallback order, use [NNBTRandomSelector].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], restarts from the first child on every tick instead of resuming the previously running child.
